caption: The drawing depicts three blue-green glass bottles with embossed designs and text, arranged against a plain beige background. The largest bottle, centered in the foreground, is pear-shaped with a narrow neck and decorative swirling patterns. The text "LOUISVILLE KY" is embossed in capital letters across its front. To the upper left, a smaller similarly-shaped bottle is shown with the text "GLASS WORKS" embossed on it and a similar style of swirling decoration. In the upper right, a third bottle is depicted in a more vertical orientation, showing more of its side with vertical ribbed patterns and no visible text. All three bottles exhibit a translucent bluish-green color and are outlined with crisp lines, with light reflections depicted on their surfaces. The composition is arranged so that the largest bottle is centered at the bottom, with the two smaller bottles positioned diagonally above on either side. A small, simple black line near the lower left edge indicates scale.
